task_definition.title: MQ-refactor θ: SpeculationController — explicit permit ownership + merger state machine (R3+R5)
task_definition.description:
Reify the merger loop's implicit speculation state machine into a SpeculationController object owning what are today six loop-locals (:8730–8756): spec_base, prefetched, held_spec_permit, pending_spec_base, pending_predecessor (task-1862 late-arrival attach), exited_via_sentinel stays loop-local. The controller owns the _speculation_slot permit lifecycle with EXPLICIT ownership-transfer semantics: acquire-on-lookahead (:9248), transfer-to-verifier-on-put (:9236–9238), retain-for-late-arrival (:9287), release-on-fallback/abort/shutdown (:8835, :9324, :9356, :9364), cascade release stays with ζ's chokepoint (was_speculative). Suggested surface: on_merge_success(commit) → prefetch decision; on_dequeue(req) → base_sha (ATTACH/FALLBACK per :8818–8841 four-condition rule); on_abort(); on_shutdown(). Preserve the documented double-release tolerance (plain Semaphore — do NOT convert to BoundedSemaphore, :9216–9232) and the DD1 coalesce gate condition (spec_base/prefetched/pending all clear, :8786). Expose controller state via a snapshot() 'speculation' key (additive). The permit-conservation identity (:217–228) becomes a queryable property for task ι.

PRD: plans/merge-queue-modularization-invariants-prd.md task θ.

User-observable signal: a permit-conservation property test across prefetch/attach/fallback/cascade/shutdown scenarios asserts semaphore value + controller-held + inflight-speculative == K at every await point; snapshot() gains the speculation-state key (dashboard-visible).
Consumer: _merger_loop; task ι (conservation audit reads controller-held count); snapshot/dashboard.
